_说明: 初见森林的森林动物性格测试（页面上不要出现 MBTI 字样）。questions：12 道题，每个维度 3 道；选 a 记前一端（E / S / T / J），选 b 记后一端（I / N / F / P）。dimensions：四个维度的可爱命名，以及'你们的组合'卡片用的句子（same_first 两人都是前一端、same_second 两人都是后一端、different 两人不同）。 spirit：选了这个选项后森林小精灵的俏皮回应。discovery：每完成一个维度的 3 题后弹出的'森林发现'卡片，按票多的一端显示。

same_first.zh: 你们都是热闹派，约上朋友一起出去玩，能量满格。
same_first.en: You're both Sunny: grab some friends, head out, and you're fully charged.

same_second.zh: 你们都喜欢安静的陪伴，一起窝在家里就是最好的约会。
same_second.en: You both love quiet company; curling up at home together is the perfect date.

different.zh: 一个热闹、一个安静：热闹派带对方看看新世界，安静派给两个人留一个温暖的小窝。
different.en: One Sunny, one Cozy: the Sunny one opens new doors, and the Cozy one keeps a warm nest for two.

E.zh: 你像清晨的小太阳，和大家在一起时最有活力。
E.en: Like a little morning sun, you shine brightest around others.

I.zh: 你像树洞里的小夜灯，安静的时光最能让你充电。
I.en: Like a night-light in a tree hollow, quiet time recharges you best.

same_first.zh: 你们都很务实，把每一天都过得踏踏实实。
same_first.en: You're both Grounded, making every day steady and real.

same_second.zh: 你们都爱做梦，聊起未来能聊一整晚。
same_second.en: You're both Dreamy; talk about the future can last all night.

different.zh: 一个脚踏实地、一个天马行空：梦想派负责画蓝图，务实派负责把它变成真的。
different.en: One Grounded, one Dreamy: the dreamer sketches the plan, and the grounded one makes it real.

S.zh: 你的脚步很踏实，总能注意到身边小小的美好。
S.en: Your steps are steady, and you notice the little lovely things around you.

N.zh: 你的脑袋里有一片星空，总在想象远方和以后。
N.en: There's a sky full of stars in your head, always imagining what's ahead.

same_first.zh: 你们都爱讲道理，遇到问题会一起冷静地想办法。
same_first.en: You're both Clever, calmly working things out together when problems come up.

same_second.zh: 你们都很照顾彼此的感受，说话总是软软的。
same_second.en: You're both Tender, always gentle with each other's feelings.

different.zh: 一个讲道理、一个讲感受：闹别扭时先抱一抱，再一起想办法。
different.en: One Clever, one Tender: when you clash, hug first, then solve it together.

T.zh: 你遇事先想清楚，是两个人里可靠的小军师。
T.en: You think things through first: the steady strategist of the two.

F.zh: 你最在意彼此的感受，心里装着软软的温柔。
F.en: You care most about how you both feel, soft and warm inside.

same_first.zh: 你们都是计划控，旅行攻略可以一起做到完美。
same_first.en: You're both Planners; together your travel plans can be perfect.

same_second.zh: 你们都随心走，说走就走的约会最适合你们。
same_second.en: You're both Wanderers; spontaneous dates suit you best.

different.zh: 一个爱计划、一个随心走：计划控定好大方向，随心派负责制造惊喜。
different.en: One Planner, one Wanderer: the planner sets the course, and the wanderer brings the surprises.

J.zh: 你喜欢把日子安排得井井有条，让人特别安心。
J.en: You like your days neatly planned, and that helps others feel safe.

P.zh: 你喜欢随风走走看，总能给日子带来小惊喜。
P.en: You like to drift with the breeze and bring little surprises to each day.

all_same.zh: 你们是同一种小动物，默契满分！
all_same.en: You're the same little animal, a perfect match!

none_same.zh: 你们几乎完全相反，正好可以互相补位。
none_same.en: You're almost complete opposites, which means you fill each other's gaps.

some_same.zh: 你们有 {n} 个地方一模一样，也各有各的可爱。
some_same.en: You match on {n} of 4 traits, and each bring your own charm.

text.zh: 小岛周末开派对，你会……
text.en: The island is throwing a weekend party. You…

text.zh: 第一个冲去，顺便认识新朋友
text.en: Rush in first and make new friends along the way

spirit.zh: 哇，派对小火箭出发！记得给我留块蛋糕～
spirit.en: Whoosh, party rocket launched! Save me a slice of cake~

text.zh: 带杯热可可，找个角落和熟人聊天
text.en: Bring a hot chocolate and chat with old friends in a corner

spirit.zh: 角落里的热可可最香了，我也想蹭一口。
spirit.en: Corner cocoa is the coziest. Can I have a sip?

text.zh: 累了一周，最能让你回血的是……
text.en: After a long week, what recharges you most is…

text.zh: 约朋友出去吃一顿
text.en: Going out for a meal with friends

spirit.zh: 吃饱饱，电量满格！
spirit.en: Full tummy, full battery!

text.zh: 一个人窝在被子里追剧
text.en: Curling up alone under a blanket with a show

spirit.zh: 被窝结界已开启，谁也别想打扰。
spirit.en: Blanket fort activated. Do not disturb!

text.zh: 森林里有只陌生小动物向你打招呼
text.en: A little animal you've never met waves at you in the forest

text.zh: 开心地和它聊起来
text.en: Happily start chatting with it

spirit.zh: 它一定被你的热情暖到了！
spirit.en: Your warm hello just made its day!

text.zh: 礼貌点头，慢慢熟悉
text.en: Nod politely and warm up slowly

spirit.zh: 慢慢来，好朋友都是一点点熟起来的。
spirit.en: Slow and steady. Best friends grow little by little.

text.zh: 一起去海边，你最先注意到……
text.en: At the beach together, the first thing you notice is…

text.zh: 浪花的声音和沙子的温度
text.en: The sound of the waves and the warmth of the sand

spirit.zh: 沙子暖暖的，浪花哗啦啦，你很会感受当下呢。
spirit.en: Warm sand, swishing waves. You really live in the moment.

text.zh: 想象海的另一边有什么
text.en: Wondering what lies on the other side of the sea

spirit.zh: 海的另一边？说不定住着一只会唱歌的鲸鱼！
spirit.en: The other side of the sea? Maybe a singing whale lives there!

text.zh: TA 问"我们以后会怎样？"
text.en: Your partner asks, “What will we be like in the future?”

text.zh: 说说下个月想一起做的事
text.en: Talk about what you want to do together next month

spirit.zh: 下个月的计划，我已经帮你记在树叶上啦。
spirit.en: Next month's plans, noted on a leaf for you.

text.zh: 描绘十年后的小家
text.en: Describe your little home ten years from now

spirit.zh: 十年后的小家，记得给我留一个窗台。
spirit.en: Your home in ten years? Save me a spot on the windowsill.

text.zh: 拼一个新家具，你会……
text.en: Putting together new furniture, you…

text.zh: 按说明书一步一步来
text.en: Follow the instructions step by step

spirit.zh: 一步一步来，螺丝一颗都不会多出来！
spirit.en: Step by step, and not a single screw left over!

text.zh: 先看图大概想象，边拼边改
text.en: Glance at the picture, picture it, and adjust as you go

spirit.zh: 边拼边改，说不定拼出一个新发明。
spirit.en: Adjusting as you go. You might invent something new!

text.zh: TA 抱怨工作的烦心事，你第一反应是……
text.en: Your partner vents about a rough day at work. Your first reaction is…

text.zh: 帮 TA 分析怎么解决
text.en: Help them work out how to fix it

spirit.zh: 小军师上线！烦心事先别跑。
spirit.en: Strategist mode on! Problems, don't run away.

text.zh: 先抱抱 TA，说"辛苦了"
text.en: Hug them first and say “that sounds tough”

spirit.zh: 抱抱是森林里最灵的魔法。
spirit.en: A hug is the strongest magic in the forest.

text.zh: 两个人意见不同时，你更在意……
text.en: When you two disagree, you care more about…

text.zh: 哪个方案更合理
text.en: Which plan makes more sense

spirit.zh: 叮！公平的小天平摆好啦。
spirit.en: Ding! The little scale of fairness is ready.

text.zh: 两个人的感受是否都被照顾
text.en: Whether both of your feelings are looked after

spirit.zh: 两颗心都被照顾到，才是真的赢了。
spirit.en: When both hearts are looked after, everyone wins.

text.zh: 挑礼物时你会……
text.en: When choosing a gift, you…

text.zh: 选实用、对方真的用得上的
text.en: Pick something practical they'll really use

spirit.zh: 实用的礼物，TA 每次用都会想起你。
spirit.en: A practical gift: they'll think of you every time they use it.

text.zh: 选有纪念意义、能让对方感动的
text.en: Pick something meaningful that will touch their heart

spirit.zh: 这份心意，TA 会收藏很久很久。
spirit.en: A gift like that gets treasured for a long, long time.

text.zh: 旅行前一天，你的状态是……
text.en: The day before a trip, you are…

text.zh: 行程表早做好，连餐厅都订了
text.en: Itinerary done, even the restaurants are booked

spirit.zh: 连餐厅都订好了？请收下我的小星星！
spirit.en: Restaurants already booked? Here's a gold star!

text.zh: 背包还没收，到了再说
text.en: Haven't packed yet; you'll figure it out there

spirit.zh: 说走就走！背包里记得塞点零食。
spirit.en: Off we go! Don't forget snacks in that backpack.

text.zh: 周末突然空出一整天，你会……
text.en: A whole free day suddenly opens up this weekend. You…

text.zh: 列清单把想做的事安排好
text.en: Make a list and plan out what to do

spirit.zh: 清单写好，一件一件打勾超满足！
spirit.en: A list to tick off one by one. So satisfying!

text.zh: 看心情，走到哪算哪
text.en: Follow your mood and see where the day goes

spirit.zh: 跟着风走，今天会遇到什么呢？
spirit.en: Following the breeze. Who knows what today brings?

text.zh: 约会快迟到了，你会……
text.en: You might be late for a date. You…

text.zh: 早早出门，绝不让 TA 等
text.en: Leave early. You'd never keep them waiting

spirit.zh: 准时小达人，TA 一定很安心。
spirit.en: Always on time. They must feel so cared for.

text.zh: 慢慢来，到了给 TA 一个大大的笑脸
text.en: Take it easy and greet them with a big smile

spirit.zh: 慢吞吞的小乌龟，带着最大的笑脸到啦！
spirit.en: Slow little turtle, arriving with the biggest smile!
